# PXRFusion credits

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_credits.py from docs/dependency-inventory.json. -->

PXRFusion is developed by POLYGONICS SAS, building on GodotGaussianSplatting by Ethan Truong (2Retr0). The original Gaussian splatting implementation is retained and extended under MIT. Runtime transformation tools use Gizmo3D by Christopher Charbonneau (chrisizeful), derived from Godot Engine editor code.

Original additions and modifications owned by POLYGONICS SAS; upstream copyrights remain with their respective owners.

Project code is MIT licensed. Third-party code, models, fonts and other assets retain their respective terms. Notices do not resolve missing ownership or redistribution evidence.
